sections.changelog: v1.2.103: Plugin Studio can now search and install from the WordPress.org directory and upload plugin ZIPs from Studio. MV panel layering was lowered so WordPress/Bricks modals can appear above MV panels, the Bricks media bridge now catches more image/SVG/media/background controls, Structure/Elements hide settings no longer hide panels that are configured to float, Content Studio labels separate Studio editing from Bricks editing, and ACF/JetEngine CPT detection was expanded.
